integrity: Coarea normalization, Fourier partial fractions, polynomial cancellation, residue coprimality, Gauss irreducibility, and component distinctness are proved in RESULT.md. Finite exact and convex-hull computations support but do not replace the proof. No external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For centered standard cross-polytopes in integer dimensions n>=4, not arbitrary bodies or translated sections. Real algebraic hypersurfaces extend beyond topological boundary patches. Classical indexed and some related current literature inspected; unindexed equivalents cannot be excluded. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: Exact algebraic-boundary degrees for intersection bodies of cross-polytopes
